view_contract: In-game movement sheet is AutoSprite-derived rear/side 3/4 flight. Rightward movement uses the unflipped sheet with the right face edge and one blue eye slightly visible; leftward movement uses the existing renderer mirror so the left face edge is slightly visible. The long ear-like side appendages are the wings and visibly flap up/down during movement while the body stays mostly stable.

body_source.asset_name: Rabi Back SD Companion Base 20260606 v1
body_source.reason: Preserves the Maribo-style rear/side movement body and direction-side face edge without front rotation.

earwing_source.asset_name: Rabi Live2D SD Identity Source 20260606 v2
earwing_source.prompt: Side/rear 3/4 right flight loop. Body nearly fixed, no twisting, no full front turn. Ear-like appendages act as wings, large vertical flapping up/down. Tail bob.
earwing_source.reason: Supplies the accepted up/down ear-wing flap motion that the prior movement sheet was missing.

rejected_autosprite_candidates.reason: Too front-facing for an in-game movement sheet.
Ear flap improved, but loop rotated through front-facing/prop-like frames.
Strong flap prompt caused broken alpha/form frames.

processing.tool: AutoSprite animate_asset sources + deterministic alpha composite + Pillow runtime repack
processing.operation: Composited the stable rear/side body and face edge from the AutoSprite-selected movement sheet with the ear-wing appendage motion from the newer AutoSprite flap sheet; discarded the front body from the flap sheet, kept only outer ear-wing appendage regions, scaled the final composite into a 118px safe box, and repacked 25 runtime cells at 128px.
processing.reason: Rabi movement must read as a ghost companion flying by flapping its ear-like appendages, not as a body-twist loop.
